usage: `rhi.DumpMemory`（可带参数，具体见帮助说明）
help: Dumps RHI memory stats to the log

usage: `rhi.DumpResourceCounts`（可带参数，具体见帮助说明）
help: Dumps RHI resource counts to the log

usage: `rhi.DumpResourceMemory`（可带参数，具体见帮助说明）
help: Dumps RHI resource memory stats to the log\n

usage: `rhi.EnableConsole120Fps=<值>` / `rhi.EnableConsole120Fps <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Enable Console 120fps if Monitor supports it and Console is properly setup

usage: `RHI.FeatureSetLimit=<值>` / `RHI.FeatureSetLimit <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: If set to 10, limit D3D RHI to D3D10 feature level. Otherwise, it will use default. Changing this at run-time has no effect. (default is -1)

usage: `RHI.MaximumFrameLatency=<值>` / `RHI.MaximumFrameLatency <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Number of frames that can be queued for render.

usage: `RHI.MaxSyncCounter=<值>` / `RHI.MaxSyncCounter <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Maximum sync counter to smooth out vsync transitions.

usage: `rhi.Metal.BinaryCacheDebugOutput=<值>` / `rhi.Metal.BinaryCacheDebugOutput <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Enable to output logging information for PSO Binary cache default(0) \n

usage: `rhi.Metal.BufferScribble=<值>` / `rhi.Metal.BufferScribble <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Debug option: when enabled will scribble over the buffer contents with a single value when releasing buffer objects, or regions thereof. (Default: 0, Off)

usage: `rhi.Metal.CacheShaderPipelines=<值>` / `rhi.Metal.CacheShaderPipelines <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: When enabled (1, default) cache all graphics pipeline state objects created in MetalRHI for the life of the program, this trades memory for performance as creating PSOs is expensive in Metal.\n

usage: `rhi.Metal.ConcurrentDispatch=<值>` / `rhi.Metal.ConcurrentDispatch <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Whether concurrent dispatch is on or off: default on

usage: `rhi.Metal.DefaultTransferAllocation=<值>` / `rhi.Metal.DefaultTransferAllocation <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Default size of a single entry in the upload pool.

usage: `rhi.Metal.DefaultUniformBufferAllocation=<值>` / `rhi.Metal.DefaultUniformBufferAllocation <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Default size of a uniform buffer allocation.

usage: `rhi.Metal.DisableIOSMemoryless=<值>` / `rhi.Metal.DisableIOSMemoryless <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: If true, disabled the use of Memoryless textures on iOS

usage: `rhi.Metal.ForceIOSTexturesShared=<值>` / `rhi.Metal.ForceIOSTexturesShared <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: If true, forces all textures to be Shared on iOS

usage: `rhi.Metal.ForceNoFence=<值>` / `rhi.Metal.ForceNoFence <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: [IOS] When enabled, act as if -nometalfence was on the commandline\n

usage: `rhi.Metal.ForceNoHeap=<值>` / `rhi.Metal.ForceNoHeap <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: [IOS] When enabled, act as if -nometalheap was on the commandline\n

usage: `rhi.Metal.HeapBufferBytesToCompact=<值>` / `rhi.Metal.HeapBufferBytesToCompact <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: When enabled (> 0) this will force MetalRHI to compact the given number of bytes each frame into older buffer heaps from newer ones in order to defragment memory and reduce wastage.\n

usage: `rhi.Metal.InsertCounterSampleBarrier=<值>` / `rhi.Metal.InsertCounterSampleBarrier <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Whether to insert a counter sampler barrier to provide the most accurate timings. (default: true)\n

usage: `rhi.Metal.MaxBucketSize=<值>` / `rhi.Metal.MaxBucketSize <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Set the Max Bucket Size for the Pooled Buffer. (Default: 33547255)

usage: `rhi.Metal.MaxOutstandingAsyncTexUploads=<值>` / `rhi.Metal.MaxOutstandingAsyncTexUploads <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: The maximum number of outstanding asynchronous texture uploads allowed to be pending in Metal. After the limit is reached the next upload will wait for all outstanding operations to complete and purge the waiting free-lists in order to reduce peak memory consumption. Defaults to 0 (infinite), set to a value > 0 limit the number.

usage: `rhi.Metal.MaxQueryBufferSize=<值>` / `rhi.Metal.MaxQueryBufferSize <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Maximum size of the the query buffer in a single context. Default = 512kb on Mac and 256k on iOS

usage: `rhi.Metal.NonBlockingPresent=<值>` / `rhi.Metal.NonBlockingPresent <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: When enabled (> 0) this will force MetalRHI to query if a back-buffer is available to present and if not will skip the frame. Only functions on macOS, it is ignored on iOS/tvOS.\n

usage: `rhi.Metal.PresentFramePacing=<值>` / `rhi.Metal.PresentFramePacing <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Specify the desired frame rate for presentation (iOS 10.3+ only, default: 0.0f, off

usage: `rhi.Metal.QueryUseControlPrecisionBit=<值>` / `rhi.Metal.QueryUseControlPrecisionBit <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Whether to use VisibilityResultModeCounting (if supported) when doing a render query. (Default : 1 (on), 0 (off))\n

usage: `rhi.Metal.ResourceDeferDeleteNumFrames=<值>` / `rhi.Metal.ResourceDeferDeleteNumFrames <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Debug option: set to the number of frames that must have passed before resource free-lists are processed and resources disposed of. (Default: 0, Off)

usage: `rhi.Metal.ResourcePurgeInPool=<值>` / `rhi.Metal.ResourcePurgeInPool <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Use the SetPurgeableState function to allow the OS to reclaim memory from resources while they are unused in the pools. (Default: 0, Off)

usage: `rhi.Metal.ResourcePurgeOnDelete=<值>` / `rhi.Metal.ResourcePurgeOnDelete <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: When enabled all MTLResource objects will have their backing stores purged on release - any subsequent access will be invalid and cause a command-buffer failure. Useful for making intermittent resource lifetime errors more common and easier to track. (Default: 0, Off)

usage: `rhi.Metal.RuntimeDebugLevel=<值>` / `rhi.Metal.RuntimeDebugLevel <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: The level of debug validation performed by MetalRHI in addition to the underlying Metal API & validation layer.\n

usage: `rhi.Metal.SampleBlitEncoderTimings=<值>` / `rhi.Metal.SampleBlitEncoderTimings <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Whether to include Blit Encoder Timings in GPU Stats, can cause poor perf due to splitting encoders: off

usage: `rhi.Metal.SampleComputeEncoderTimings=<值>` / `rhi.Metal.SampleComputeEncoderTimings <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Whether to include Compute Encoder Timings in GPU Stats, can cause poor perf due to splitting encoders: on

usage: `rhi.Metal.ShaderPipelineCache.Save`（可带参数，具体见帮助说明）
help: Save the current pipeline file cache.

usage: `rhi.Metal.ShaderValidation.ShaderName=<值>` / `rhi.Metal.ShaderValidation.ShaderName <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Enable to set shader validation on compute shaders with a name\n

usage: `rhi.Metal.ShaderValidation.Type=<值>` / `rhi.Metal.ShaderValidation.Type <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Enable to set shader validation on specific types\n

usage: `rhi.Metal.SupportsIntermediateBackBuffer=<值>` / `rhi.Metal.SupportsIntermediateBackBuffer <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: When enabled (> 0) allocate an intermediate texture to use as the back-buffer & blit from there into the actual device back-buffer (Off by default (0))

usage: `rhi.Metal.TargetTransferAllocationLimit=<值>` / `rhi.Metal.TargetTransferAllocationLimit <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Target Allocation limit for the upload staging buffer pool.

usage: `rhi.Metal.TargetUniformAllocationLimit=<值>` / `rhi.Metal.TargetUniformAllocationLimit <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Target Allocation limit for the uniform buffer pool.

usage: `rhi.Metal.UseEventForGPUFence=<值>` / `rhi.Metal.UseEventForGPUFence <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: When enabled use an Event to signal GPUFence completion to save splitting command buffers default: on

usage: `rhi.Metal.UseTexGetBytes=<值>` / `rhi.Metal.UseTexGetBytes <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: If true prefer using -[MTLTexture getBytes:...] to retreive texture data, creating a temporary shared/managed texture to copy from private texture storage when required, rather than using a temporary MTLBuffer. This works around data alignment bugs on some GPU vendor's drivers and may be more appropriate on iOS. (Default: True)

usage: `rhi.PresentThreshold.Bottom=<值>` / `rhi.PresentThreshold.Bottom <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Specifies the percentage of the screen from the bottom where tearing is allowed.\n

usage: `rhi.PresentThreshold.Top=<值>` / `rhi.PresentThreshold.Top <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Specifies the percentage of the screen from the top where tearing is allowed.\n

usage: `RHI.RefreshPercentageBeforePresent=<值>` / `RHI.RefreshPercentageBeforePresent <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: The percentage of the refresh period to wait before presenting.

usage: `rhi.ReservedResources.VirtualSizeWarningGB=<值>` / `rhi.ReservedResources.VirtualSizeWarningGB <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Report a warning if total allocated virtual size of all reserved resources exceeds this budget.\n

usage: `rhi.SyncAllowEarlyKick=<值>` / `rhi.SyncAllowEarlyKick <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: When 1, allows the RHI vsync thread to kick off the next frame early if we've missed the vsync.

usage: `rhi.SyncAllowVariable=<值>` / `rhi.SyncAllowVariable <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: When 1, allows the RHI to use variable refresh rate, if supported by the output hardware.

usage: `rhi.SyncInterval=<值>` / `rhi.SyncInterval <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Determines the frequency of VSyncs in supported RHIs.\n

usage: `RHI.SyncRefreshThreshold=<值>` / `RHI.SyncRefreshThreshold <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Threshold for time above which vsync will be disabled as a percentage of the refresh rate.

usage: `rhi.SyncSlackMS=<值>` / `rhi.SyncSlackMS <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Increases input latency by this many milliseconds, to help performance (trade-off tunable). Gamethread will be kicked off this many milliseconds before the vsync

usage: `RHI.SyncThreshold=<值>` / `RHI.SyncThreshold <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Number of consecutive 'fast' frames before vsync is enabled.

usage: `RHI.SyncWithDWM=<值>` / `RHI.SyncWithDWM <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: If true, synchronize with the desktop window manager for vblank.

usage: `RHI.TargetRefreshRate=<值>` / `RHI.TargetRefreshRate <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: If non-zero, the display will never update more often than the target refresh rate (in Hz).

usage: `rhi.TrackDescriptorCallstacks=<值>` / `rhi.TrackDescriptorCallstacks <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: When enabled, captures callstacks for descriptor allocations to help diagnose double-free bugs. Requires rhi.TrackOutstandingDescriptorAllocations.

usage: `rhi.TrackOutstandingDescriptorAllocations=<值>` / `rhi.TrackOutstandingDescriptorAllocations <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: When enabled, tracks outstanding descriptor allocations to detect double-free and leak bugs.

usage: `RHI.TransientAllocator.BufferCacheSize=<值>` / `RHI.TransientAllocator.BufferCacheSize <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: The maximum number of RHI buffers to cache on each heap before garbage collecting.

usage: `RHI.TransientAllocator.GarbageCollectLatency=<值>` / `RHI.TransientAllocator.GarbageCollectLatency <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Amount of update cycles before memory is reclaimed.

usage: `RHI.TransientAllocator.MinimumHeapSize=<值>` / `RHI.TransientAllocator.MinimumHeapSize <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Minimum size of an RHI transient heap in MB. Heaps will default to this size and grow to the maximum based on the first allocation (Default 128).

usage: `RHI.TransientAllocator.ParallelResourceCreation=<值>` / `RHI.TransientAllocator.ParallelResourceCreation <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: If enabled, a task is launched for each placed resource that is created.

usage: `RHI.TransientAllocator.TextureCacheSize=<值>` / `RHI.TransientAllocator.TextureCacheSize <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: The maximum number of RHI textures to cache on each heap before garbage collecting.

usage: `rhi.UseSubmissionThread=<值>` / `rhi.UseSubmissionThread <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Whether to enable the RHI submission thread.\n
